# Are your unlimited, pack and drop-in prices making your studio money?

> Free pricing planner for yoga, pilates, barre and cycling studios: unlimited memberships, class packs and drop-ins in; monthly profit, what each plan earns per visit, break-even class size, empty-seat value and the best unlimited price out. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
